findings.claim: An empty submodule pin is accepted and matches every gitlink commit, so an invalid `versions.toml` can report agreement with the tree.
findings.evidence: `unquote` accepts `""` as a string value, and `samePin` returns `actual.length >= pinned.length && actual.startsWith(pinned)`, which is true for `pinned === ""`; the spec requires `[submodules] "<path>" = "<sha>"` and that every submodule commit is bound to the parent gitlink.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate submodule pins before comparing, e.g. require `/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i` and report a disagreement or parse error for empty/non-hex pins.
